en.title: Payer
en.summary: One employer or insurer: their details and contacts, the bills sent to them across patients, and what they still owe.

sections.heading: Bills
sections.body: Every issued bill whose Bill to is this payer, with the patient it is for. Only people who may handle bills see this part. A bill is sent here by choosing the payer under Bill to while it is still a draft; a patient linked to this payer has it chosen already.

sections.heading: Taking their payment
sections.body: Press Take a payment and enter an amount against each bill the payment covers — one bank transfer can settle many patients' bills. Each bill's status follows, and the payment gets one receipt number. Cash needs the cash drawer open at this branch.

sections.heading: Details
sections.body: Edit the details, the address and the contact people. Take care with the TIN: it identifies the organisation on paperwork.

sections.heading: What they cover
sections.body: The share of each bill the payer pays (100% for an employer paying in full), a yearly limit per member, and whether they must approve treatment first. A bill billed to them is divided when it is issued: the payer's bill keeps their part, and the rest goes to the patient on a co-payment bill of its own, numbered and linked. A bill that runs past the member's yearly limit, or past their pre-authorisation, is divided the same way. Changing the terms needs billing.invoice and applies to bills issued from then on.

sections.heading: Claims
sections.body: Choose a month and Open the claim: every bill billed to this payer in it, with each patient's member number and pre-authorisation reference, what it came to and what is still owed. Print it to send, or download it as a spreadsheet.

am.title: ከፋይ
am.summary: አንድ አሠሪ ወይም መድን ሰጪ፦ ዝርዝሮቹና ተጠሪዎቹ፣ በተለያዩ ታካሚዎች ስም የተላኩለት ደረሰኞች፣ እና አሁንም ያለበት ዕዳ።

sections.heading: ደረሰኞች
sections.body: "Bill to" ይህ ከፋይ የሆነ እያንዳንዱ የተሰጠ ደረሰኝ፣ ከታካሚው ስም ጋር። ይህን ክፍል የሚያዩት ደረሰኝ መያዝ የሚችሉ ብቻ ናቸው። ደረሰኝ ገና ረቂቅ ሳለ በ"Bill to" ከፋዩን በመምረጥ ወደዚህ ይላካል፤ ከዚህ ከፋይ ጋር የተገናኘ ታካሚ ከሆነ አስቀድሞ ተመርጧል።

sections.heading: ክፍያቸውን መቀበል
sections.body: "Take a payment"ን ይጫኑና ክፍያው ለሚሸፍነው እያንዳንዱ ደረሰኝ መጠን ያስገቡ — አንድ የባንክ ዝውውር የብዙ ታካሚዎችን ደረሰኞች ሊከፍል ይችላል። የእያንዳንዱ ደረሰኝ ሁኔታ ይለወጣል፤ ክፍያው አንድ የደረሰኝ ቁጥር ያገኛል። ጥሬ ገንዘብ በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ የገንዘብ መሳቢያው ክፍት መሆንን ይፈልጋል።

sections.heading: ዝርዝሮች
sections.body: ዝርዝሮቹን፣ አድራሻውንና ተጠሪዎቹን ማስተካከል። በTIN ይጠንቀቁ፦ ድርጅቱን በሰነዶች ላይ የሚለየው እሱ ነው።

sections.heading: የሚሸፍኑት
sections.body: ከፋዩ የሚከፍለው የእያንዳንዱ ሂሳብ ድርሻ (ሙሉ ለሚከፍል አሠሪ 100%)፣ ለአንድ አባል ዓመታዊ ገደብ፣ እና ሕክምናን አስቀድመው ማጽደቅ እንዳለባቸው። ለእነሱ የሚወጣ ሂሳብ ሲወጣ ይከፈላል፤ የከፋዩ ሂሳብ የእነሱን ድርሻ ይይዛል፣ ቀሪው በተለየ የታካሚ ድርሻ ሂሳብ ለታካሚው ይወጣል። ከዓመታዊ ገደቡ ወይም ከቅድመ ፈቃዱ በላይ የሆነ ሂሳብም በተመሳሳይ ይከፈላል።

sections.heading: የይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች
sections.body: ወር መርጠው «Open the claim»ን ይጫኑ፤ በዚያ ወር ለዚህ ከፋይ የወጡ ሂሳቦች ሁሉ ከታካሚዎቹ የአባልነት ቁጥርና የቅድመ ፈቃድ መለያ ጋር ይታያሉ። ለመላክ ያትሙት፣ ወይም በተመን ሉህ ያውርዱት።
